- [2026-05-08T08:32:10.941Z] VERTICAL SLICE LIVE-PLAY — 2026-05-08. Walked Stage 4 + first-night-done state, jumped to bedroom, played setter→loop→finisher end-to-end. SETTER fires (priority 10 beats existing canvas at 9). Locked-sibling pattern works ('Look at him a moment, then look away.' shows because Maya corruption=22 < threshold=30). LOOP HUB fires on 'Get into bed' click. Random-range mutations work — 7 actions across 3 archetypes produced varied deltas: Make out hit min(2,2), Tease hit max(4 NPC)+min(2 player), Service rolled 8/6/7/8/6 NPC + 1/1/3/2/1 player. Last-action prose [group] blocks render correctly per loop_last_action_* flag. Climax-elect 'Make him cum.' appears at npc_pleasure>=35 — confirmed. Finisher fires with climax prose + Type C exits. 'Stay through' applies all effects: corruption+2, energy-8, Frank.trust+1, Frank.corruption+2, Frank.arousal-3, Diana.awareness+1, talked_today set, ready_for_climax cleared, time +90min.
- [2026-05-08T08:32:10.997Z] ISSUE 1 — UX: 2 clicks per action instead of 1. Loop action click → routes to Location_Frank's_Bedroom auto-router → player must click Frank portrait again to re-enter loop hub. Adds friction every beat. FIX: change in-loop action exits from targetType='trigger' to targetType='node' pointing directly at the loop hub canvas's base node. Bypasses the location's NPC-portrait click gate. Cross-canvas node routing already verified working.
- [2026-05-08T08:32:11.055Z] ISSUE 2 — Frank.arousal went NEGATIVE (-3). My finisher used value=-3 op=add WITHOUT clamp=true. Runtime applyTraitEffect defaults clampFlag=true only when 'undefined or null' — but renderer passes literal 'false' for missing clamp. So undefined-in-TOML becomes false-in-JS (no clamp). FIX: either add clamp=true to all Frank.arousal -= effects, OR make the renderer default to clamp=true when omitted (matches runtime intent). Latter is the right fix; former is a TOML papering-over.
- [2026-05-08T08:32:11.108Z] ISSUE 3 — 'relation' trait silently dropped. I declared {trait='relation', op='add', value=1} on Frank in finisher exits + setter talk action. Frank's core_traits only has {love, trust, corruption, arousal}. applyTraitEffect's 'Unknown op; do nothing' branch eats the effect silently — no error. FIX: change all 'relation' to 'love' (TLS convention) OR add missing-trait warnings at render time. Latter would catch authoring typos cheaply.
- [2026-05-08T08:32:11.161Z] WHAT WORKED — 9 distinct features verified live: (1) priority-based canvas selection (10 beats 9), (2) flag-based gating (in_loop_mode + ready_for_climax), (3) random-range pleasure mutations (engine extension shipped same day), (4) per-action [group] blocks for last-action prose, (5) flag-driven mutually-exclusive groups, (6) locked-sibling pattern at menu items (corruption gate at 30), (7) climax-elect threshold gating ('Make him cum' appears at >=35), (8) finisher-canvas closure effects (full Type C bundle), (9) NEW badge truth-matching (fires on Frank when finisher unvisited, after climax flag set).
- [2026-05-08T08:32:11.212Z] DESIGN VERDICT — vertical slice WORKS end-to-end. The 3-canvas pattern (setter+loop+finisher) is authorable in pure TOML against today's engine + the random-range extension. UX issue (Issue 1) is the only meaningful blocker for player feel — 2 clicks per action is jarring. With targetType=node fix, the loop becomes 1-click-per-action and matches Shady Deals' feel. Issues 2+3 are polish (silent-fail authoring traps that the engine should warn about).
